selected_primary_idea.title: Auditable Multistage Pandemic-Escalation Forecasting
selected_primary_idea.summary: Estimate and calibrate stage-specific regional risk states that support surveillance and preparedness decisions, not exact prediction of the next pandemic.
selected_primary_idea.research_object: Aggregate region-by-time-window One Health and preparedness evidence.
selected_primary_idea.mechanism: Separate upstream spillover conditions, local amplification signals, regional dissemination readiness, and decision actionability into linked but noninterchangeable states.
selected_primary_idea.intervention: Compare a calibrated multistage decision-support framework with pooled-score and signal-only baselines in a design-only evaluation protocol.
falsification: No gain in calibration, lead-time utility, or attribution compared with strong pooled baselines.
Transportability is insufficient under temporal or geographic holdouts.
Fairness and missingness diagnostics preclude responsible action recommendations.

high_risk_ideas.title: Single universal next-pandemic predictor
high_risk_ideas.reason: High novelty claim but rejected for target conflation, weak falsifiability, and unsafe overclaiming.
